Mint Dressing
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, January 1, 2010 - 1:16am

Ingredients




6 tablespoons olive oil
2 tablespoons lemon juice
3 tablespoons chopped mint
1 pch sugar
1 salt and pepper

Preparation

1 Beat the oil with the lemon juice mint sugar and salt and pepper to taste until well blended. 2 Alternatively place all theingredients in a screwtop jar and shake vigorously to combine well before serving. 3 Set aside for at least 15 minutes to allow the flavors to develop then beat or shake again before using. 4 This light and refreshing dressing would taste delicious with a cold potato salad or tossed tightly over a salad of chopped apples and herring. 5 Makes about 1/2cup
